title: Design System: eVacTrack Civic Design
scope: Operational tokens live in src/app/globals.css (Plus Jakarta Sans, 6px controls, 8px record surfaces). The extensions and components below describe the bounded Public Landing Page system (src/app/_landing/landing.css, scoped to body:has(.landing-page)). Light theme only.

lp-display.purpose: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 800, clamp(2.5rem, 1.6rem + 3.2vw, 4.25rem), lh 1.04, -0.03em. Hero only.

shadows.name: lp-shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Notes, trail cards, slots, message bubbles.

shadows.name: lp-record
shadows.purpose: Hero record floating over the photograph.

motion.name: lp-stamp
motion.purpose: Signature arrival: given-dose marks stamp onto the hero record.

motion.name: scroll-draw
motion.purpose: Schedule track, step connectors and trail thread draw in. Removed under reduced motion.

components.name: Landing Primary Button
components.description: Royal-blue action on white and pale sections.
components.html: <button class="ds-lp-btn-primary">Explore the demo <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-lp-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: #0648ef; color: #fff; font: 700 1.0625rem/1.2 'eVac Atkinson', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(6 72 239 / 0.24), 0 10px 24px -10px rgb(6 72 239 / 0.6); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 180ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lp-btn-primary svg { transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-lp-btn-primary:hover { background: #0436bd; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(6 72 239 / 0.24), 0 14px 28px -12px rgb(6 72 239 / 0.7); } .ds-lp-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-lp-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-lp-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0648ef; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-lp-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #c6d1e6; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #0b1a3a; font: 700 1.0625rem/1.2 'eVac Atkinson', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms, border-color 180ms, color 180ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lp-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #0648ef; background: #f3f6fe; color: #0a2f9e; } .ds-lp-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0648ef; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Light Button on Blue
components.description: Primary action on the royal-blue hero and closing band.
components.css: .ds-lp-btn-light { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #0a2f9e; font: 700 1.0625rem/1.2 'eVac Atkinson', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(4 20 70 / 0.2), 0 12px 28px -12px rgb(4 20 70 / 0.55); transition: background-color 180ms, box-shadow 180ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lp-btn-light:hover { background: #e5ecfd; } .ds-lp-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Service Tab
components.description: One window of the service counter (wide-screen column state). WAI-ARIA tab.
components.css: .ds-lp-tabs { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 330px; font-family: 'eVac Atkinson', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-lp-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 16px 14px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: #0b1a3a; text-align: left; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-lp-tab:hover { background: #f3f6fe; } .ds-lp-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0648ef; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-lp-tab-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #e5ecfd; color: #0648ef; } .ds-lp-tab-name { display: block; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-lp-tab-hint { display: block; color: #56627f; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-lp-tab[aria-selected='true'] { border-color: #e1e7f3; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(11 26 58 / 0.05), 0 18px 40px -24px rgb(11 26 58 / 0.28); } .ds-lp-tab[aria-selected='true'] .ds-lp-tab-icon { background: #0648ef; color: #fff; } .ds-lp-tab[aria-selected='true'] .ds-lp-tab-name { color: #0a2f9e; }

components.name: Dose Marks
components.description: Shared vocabulary: blue check = given, amber ring = due, dash = none.
components.html: Due
components.css: .ds-lp-doses { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font-family: 'eVac Atkinson', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-lp-given circle { fill: #0648ef; } .ds-lp-given path { fill: none; stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-lp-due { padding: 2px 8px; border: 1.5px solid #f2a33a; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff4e2; color: #8a4300; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-lp-none { width: 10px; height: 1.5px; border-radius: 2px; background: #c6d1e6; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: White card on a pale or ruled ground (18px; directory/access 20px; panel and close 28px).
components.html:
At the visit

The nurse enters the vaccine, dose and date while your child is still at the health center.
components.css: .ds-lp-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 20px 28px 22px; border: 1px solid #e1e7f3; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(11 26 58 / 0.05), 0 4px 12px -6px rgb(11 26 58 / 0.12); font-family: 'eVac Atkinson', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-lp-card h3 { margin: 0; color: #0b1a3a; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-lp-card p { margin: 0; color: #56627f; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.description: Honesty label on every depicted screen; amber variant for fictional demo clinics.
components.css: .ds-lp-sample { padding: 3px 9px; border: 1px dashed #c6d1e6; border-radius: 999px; color: #56627f; font: 700 0.75rem/1.2 'eVac Atkinson', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-lp-fictional { padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff4e2; color: #8a4300; font: 700 0.8125rem/1.4 'eVac Atkinson', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The landing page works like a health center's front counter: a royal-blue arrival that names the service and both account actions, then one counter with five service windows, each showing a sample of its real screen. Its material comes from the paper Immunization Card, which contributes the hairline ruling and the dose marks. The page opens and closes with a saturated blue band and uses white and pale-blue reading sections between them, with a navy footer.
keyCharacteristics: Royal-blue hero and closing band with the card's ruling as a ground texture.
White and pale-blue sections that alternate, each with a single-colour H2.
One dose-mark vocabulary reused by every depicted record.
A tabbed service counter instead of a grid of icon cards.
One arrival moment, with lines that draw as they scroll into view, and no other decorative motion.
Sample data is always labelled, and no claim appears without a source.

rules.name: The One Blue Heading Rule
rules.body: Every H2 is a single colour: Navy Ink on light grounds and white on the closing band. The only two-tone heading is the hero H1, whose second line is Soft Blue on the blue field.

rules.name: The Ruling Is Ground Rule
rules.body: The card ruling is a 1px line repeating every 40px (pale sections, --lp-rule rgb(6 72 239 / 0.06)), every 48px (blue bands, white at 7%) or every 28px (inside service stages). It appears only as a ground texture. It is masked out before it reaches the hero photograph and kept off the closing photo sheet, so no line ever crosses a photographed person.

dos: Do use Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (400/600/700/800) and the --lp-* tokens for anything on /, and nothing else.
Do keep H2s a single colour. Reserve Soft Blue (#b8ccff) for the hero H1's second line on blue.
Do reuse the dose-mark vocabulary (blue check = given, amber ring = due, dash = none) for any depicted record.
Do label every depicted screen "Sample" and every demo clinic "Fictional demo data".
Do use the ruling as a ground texture only, masked away from photographs of people.
Do keep 44px minimum targets and the 3px focus outline.
donts: Don't use landing tokens, Atkinson, or the 12–28px radii on operational pages.
Don't add kickers or eyebrows to sections. The hero badge is the only one and is a user-requested exception.
Don't add claims such as "free", statistics, or trust badges without a source.
Don't add decorative motion beyond the arrival moment and the scroll-linked line drawing, and never motion that survives prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't replace the service counter with a grid of identical icon cards.
